_comment: Fallback fixture for scripts/generate-editorial.mjs. Used only when every --feed in the run fails (for example, a sandboxed environment whose network egress proxy blocks outbound RSS fetches). Replace verifiedEditorialSource.url with a real, currently-live public report before relying on this in a real run: the script refuses to publish unless sourceText actually backs the title and any --player entities, but it cannot itself confirm the URL is genuine. Never fill this file with fabricated player stats or performance claims; it holds an attributed link brief, the same as a live feed item would.

verifiedEditorialSource.title: NFL clubs trim practice squads as Week 2 approaches
verifiedEditorialSource.description: Teams around the league finalized practice squad moves ahead of Week 2, with several clubs adding depth at receiver and cornerback.
verifiedEditorialSource.author: Example Sports Wire
